g.text: Effect of the fictional time allowance
Every plotted difference = 8 s + control reading minus 120 s + control reading.
H1: For each of 8 matched scenario pairs: (order at low outstanding quantity − order at high outstanding quantity) / (high − low outstanding quantity). Average the 8
H2: Sum (0.5 × end-of-week inventory + 1 × end-of-week backlog) across 4 roles and 24 weeks.
Zero = equal outcomes. Positive = the first named condition is higher. Negative = it is lower.
Diamond: mean of 10 paired differences. Bar: pointwise 95% paired-block bootstrap interval. Fictional framing; no model timer.
